verdict.rationale: Capsule documents a first-party data export explicitly aimed at moving to another system, plus report-data export for tools like Excel and an authenticated API. The evidence does not name the export formats or confirm that every record type is included. Missing for 10: documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), confirmation that the export covers all data types (notes, emails, attachments, custom fields), and independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete migration out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export your data for safe keeping or for transferring to another system.
Export all of your report data or save an image of your chart for import into other tools such as Excel.
Use Capsule's API to integrate with your custom or third party application.
